name: GCP
desc: Google Cloud's take on the same pipeline stack -- Cloud Storage, Dataproc (managed Spark), Cloud Monitoring, and Grafana on GCP. Google's IAM model and BigQuery are the two areas with the most genuine conceptual difference from AWS.
tip: GCP's IAM model has one real trap: permissions are almost always additive across every level (Organization, Folder, Project) with no narrower-scope-wins rule like AWS/Azure -- a broad Editor role granted at the Organization level applies everywhere beneath it, full stop. Naming this explicitly is what separates genuine GCP experience from a surface-level AWS-to-GCP word swap.
